recipe_version.title: White Bean Kale Soup
recipe_version.description: Stovetop soup of cannellini beans, fennel, diced tomato, and kale in vegetable broth.
recipe_version.serving_basis_note: Quantities are for 4 servings. One- and two-serving floors are not in this draft.
recipe_version.heat: Medium heat to soften the fennel, then a simmer. No oven.
recipe_version.doneness: Fennel is softened at 5 minutes. The soup simmers 20 minutes. Kale is tender at about 5 minutes more. Canned beans are already cooked.

ingredients.name: cannellini beans
ingredients.note: 15 oz cans. Drained and rinsed. v1 said 2 cans and did not name the size or draining. Draining is a drafter decision so the 6 cups of broth stay the liquid.

ingredients.name: vegetable broth
ingredients.note: Plain vegetable broth. Check the carton. Wheat or soy on the label would be an allergen v1 did not record.

ingredients.name: diced tomatoes
ingredients.note: 14.5 oz, with their liquid. v1 said 1 can diced and the simmer step uses them.

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: v1 said season and listed no salt. Drafter amount, added once at the end. Not kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: black pepper
ingredients.note: v1 said season and listed no pepper. Drafter amount.

steps.title: Saute the fennel
steps.body: Soften the sliced fennel in the oil over medium heat for 5 minutes. This is a pot on the stove, not a sheet pan.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.body: Add the drained beans, broth, and diced tomatoes with their liquid. Simmer 20 minutes.

steps.title: Wilt the kale and season
steps.body: Stir in the kale and cook about 5 minutes, until tender. Stir in the kosher salt and black pepper. Do not add cheese, sausage, cream, or bread.

recipe_version.dietary_label_note: Plant and dairy-free. No cheese, cream, sausage, or bread. Not a gluten-free claim, because the broth carton was not checked.
allergen_notes: No egg, milk, soy, wheat, sesame, peanut, tree_nut, shellfish, or finfish in the named foods.
